name: Ron Tototz
summary: Larry's bunk mate and closest companion in the collection — "he's Polish," from Des Moines, Iowa. He appears with Larry from the first weeks at Nha Trang (VN-0025, with Parr) through the Cholon pool outings (VN-0004, VN-0005), the beach at Nha Trang (VN-0021, VN-0022), their quarters (VN-0001, VN-0002, VN-0003), and hooch T 123 with Sarge the monkey, which he hated (VN-0017). Ron was with Larry during the bathroom shooting incident. Larry says Ron passed away about ten years ago (about 2016). His real surname is unknown; "Tototz" is a phonetic transcription of how Larry says it.
larrysRecollection: Right: Ron Tototz. He's polish and was with me during the shooting incident in the bathroom. Ron was my bunk mate. (VN-0002 Memories comment, 2026-08-13.) Ron was from Des Moines, Iowa (VN-0025 comment, 2026-08-15). Ronnie Tototz passed away about ten years ago. (Tell a Story comment, 2026-08-15.)
researchNotes: The 2026-08-15 session transformed the search picture. Two new anchors: hometown Des Moines, Iowa, and death about ten years before 2026 (~2013–2019 window). An Iowa obituary search for a Vietnam veteran with a Polish surname matching the 'Tototz' phonetic is now the most promising path to his real name — likely faster than the earlier document paths (the bathroom-shooting court-martial record, unit morning reports via NPRC), which remain open.
